title: Check: Angles of Elevation and Depression

questions.stem: The angle of elevation is measured from:

options.text: The vertical line upwards to the line of sight
The ground to the top of the object
The horizontal line upwards to the line of sight
The line of sight downwards to the horizontal

questions.explanation: The angle of elevation is the angle measured from the horizontal upwards to the line of sight when looking at an object above you.
